text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus suffered a defeat against 
Sakura Bakushin O.

Impressed by Biko Pegasus's valiant 
efforts, Sakura Bakushin O proposes their 
next contest: the 1600m Mile Championship.

Naturally, Biko Pegasus accepted the 
challenge. However, the strain from 
pushing herself too hard in the race ended 
up injuring her leg.

Fortunately, it didn't turn into a major 
injury. Upon hearing news of Biko 
Pegasus's injury, an action actor comes to 
visit her.

The actor tells a slightly disheartened 
Biko Pegasus that he wants to cheer him 
up. He then promised to come visit during 
his recovery.
